product_metadata.title: Comfort Zone CZ121WT 12” 3-Speed Oscillating Table Fan with Adjustable Tilt, Convenient Push Button Controls, Quiet Operation, White
features: 🌬️3-SPEED CONTROLS: This 3-speed oscillating fan is equipped with easy-to-use push buttons to quickly switch between low, medium and high speeds
🌬️PRECISION AIR FLOW: Constructed with an adjustable tilt and oscillating design, this quiet indoor fan can be angled, adjusted and oscillated to create a revitalizing breeze where you need it most
🌬️QUIET OPERATION: Boasting a motor that is virtually silent, this quiet office fan will not interrupt your studying or office work with a loud hum or any other annoying noises
🌬️A FOCUS ON SAFETY AND DURABILITY: Built to last, this small oscillating table fan includes a sturdy metal grill that protects the blades from debris
🌬️QUICK AND EASY ASSEMBLY: Designed for convenience, this quiet room fan is easy to assemble and attach to the accompanying plastic fan base in just a few minutes
description: With a three-speed air output design, this Comfort Zone 12" oscillating table fan can switch from gentle air circulation to a brisk, invigorating breeze with the push of a button. This versatile table fan offers a refreshing breeze that is suitable for hot summer days at your desk or humid nights beside your bed.
Oscillating Design for Increased Air Circulation

This quiet table fan is equipped with an oscillating fan head, which sways from side to side to create a gentle breeze throughout the entire room. The oscillating feature is ideal for living rooms, family movie nights and other group settings, or simply for creating a consistent breeze in a small room.

A great option for those who need a fan to sleep, this quiet fan for bedrooms creates very little noise, even when on its fastest speed function. It provides a gentle, consistent breeze while creating minimal sound, which can help provide relief on hot and humid nights.

To ensure the fan is always blowing air in the direction you want, this 3-speed oscillating fan includes an adjustable tilt, which can be pointed up or down to direct the air flow with more precision. This provides steady relief from the heat on hot summer afternoons and can be used as a sleeping fan with added control over the output.
